verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships through a public Claude Code marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace`) and native plugin installs for Devin CLI and the Antigravity Marketplace. A hands-on probe confirmed `npx skills add obra/superpowers ... --copy` writes plain SKILL.md folders into the project's `./.claude/skills/`, where they can be committed and shared with a team. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on team- or org-wide rollout (e.g., project-scoped marketplace or plugin config that auto-enables for teammates), and a single install covering every harness, since docs say each harness must be installed separately.
